Network software consists of protocols, which are rule s by which processes communicate. Protocols are either
connectionless or connection-oriented. Most networks support prot ocol hierarchies, with each layer providing
services to the layers above it and insulating them fr om the details of the protocols used in the lower layers.

characteristics, technologies, speeds, and niches. LANs cover a building and operate at high speeds. MANs
cover a city, for example, the cable television system, whic h is now used by many people to access the Internet.
